mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_uid, c.is_anonymous, c.content, c.media_urls, c.like_count, c.parent_id, c.reply_comment_id, c.reply_user_uid, c.create_time, u.username as nickname, u.avatar, ru.username AS replyNickname FROM wall_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user ru ON c.reply_user_id = ru.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
SELECT id FROM user WHERE uid = #{userUid}
SELECT id,user_uid,is_deleted FROM wall_comment WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_uid, c.is_anonymous, c.content, c.media_urls, c.like_count, c.parent_id, c.reply_comment_id, c.reply_user_uid, c.create_time, u.username as nickname, u.avatar, ru.username AS replyNickname FROM wall_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user ru ON c.reply_user_id = ru.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.like_count DESC, c.create_time DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wall_post_action(post_no, user_uid, action_type) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userUid}, 'COMMENT_LIKE')
